articles.title: How the House Financial Services Committee is taking on tokenization: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Rep. French Hill, head of the House Financial Services Committee, weighed in on outstanding policy issues in an interview with CoinDesk last month.

articles.title: Wall Street’s trillion-dollar dilemma: Why AI-powered hackers are keeping big banks off the blockchain
articles.snippet: CertiK CEO and co-founder Ronghui Gu says April was the worst month for DeFi in four years with exploits on 27 out of 30 days.

articles.title: ‘The banks will not accept it’: Dimon escalates battle over stablecoin rewards in CLARITY Act debate
articles.snippet: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon criticized Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong and warned the current CLARITY Act framework could ultimately fail, as banks and crypto firms clash over whether stablecoin issuers should be allowed to offer yield-bearing rewards that resemble bank deposits.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin shrugs off early decline, but two-month winning streak is in jeopardy
articles.snippet: A hopeful posting on Iran from President Trump helped erase morning losses.

articles.title: Kraken ‘plans’ regulated perp contracts as rivals are quick off the blocks
articles.snippet: In the wake of CFTC approval of perpetual futures contracts tied to the spot price of Bitcoin, Kraken expects to offer those to US institutional clients within "the next month."
